I got into crypto 3 years ago.
Bitcoin pulled me in with its world-changing tech.
Then came Dogecoin—people made money after Elon’s tweets.
As a beginner, I thought, “This is it.”
It wasn’t.

The SEC delays decisions on 21Shares XRP, Grayscale XRP, and Dogecoin Trusts, requesting public input.
More signs of caution as crypto ETFs expand beyond Bitcoin.
